<div id='av_section_1' class='avia-section av-3r9s408-d119929ae48e6ee81c45d17a08cee5e5 main_color avia-section-default avia-no-border-styling avia-builder-el-1 el_after_av_submenu el_before_av_section av-small-hide av-mini-hide avia-bg-style-scroll container_wrap fullsize' ><div class='container av-section-cont-open' ><div class='template-page content av-content-full alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-1864'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'>
<div class='flex_column av-3p0y37c-9bb4d96aa6dd3f399999b7726c3756f9 av_two_third avia-builder-el-2 el_before_av_one_third avia-builder-el-first first flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding ' ><section class='av_textblock_section av-3o4bqyw-f77ff7e6342783436a0b351d32c16f13 ' itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock' itemprop="text" ><h1 style="text-align: center;" data-start="1698" data-end="1758"><strong data-start="1698" data-end="1758">Kitesurfing Somabay – Your Perfect Kite Holiday in Egypt</strong></h1>
<h1 style="text-align: center;"><img decoding="async" class="nohover alignnone" src="https://thebreakers.b-cdn.net/wp-content/themes/enfold-child/images/sep.png" alt="Seperator" /></h1>
<p class="" data-start="1760" data-end="1991">Kitesurfing in Somabay is one of the top experiences you can have on the Red Sea. The Breakers Diving &#038; Surfing Lodge offers the perfect blend of lifestyle hotel comfort and access to one of Egypt’s most renowned kitesurfing spots.</p>
<p class="" data-start="1993" data-end="2236">Just <strong data-start="1998" data-end="2040">an 8-minute complimentary shuttle ride</strong> from the hotel takes you to the professional <strong data-start="2086" data-end="2104">7Bft KiteHouse</strong>. There you’ll find year-round consistent wind, flat water and a protected lagoon – perfect for beginners and advanced riders alike.</p>
<p data-start="1993" data-end="2236"><strong>What to expect:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>300+ wind days per year at a top kitesurfing location</li>
<li>Premium equipment and professional instruction at 7Bft KiteHouse</li>
<li>Personal service &#038; German-speaking staff on-site</li>
<li>Free daily shuttle service from The Breakers</li>
<li>Chill-out zone and beachfront restaurant at the kite center</li>
<li>A wide range of activities with no wind</li>
</ul>
<p class="" data-start="2552" data-end="2682">Whether you&#8217;re just starting out or looking to push your limits, Somabay offers the ideal setup for an unforgettable kite holiday.</p>
<p class="" data-start="2684" data-end="2770"><strong data-start="2684" data-end="2770">Book your kitesurf adventure now – with hotel comfort and premium wind conditions.</strong></p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><a href="https://vimeo.com/242608277" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span style="font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #109bc5; text-transform: uppercase;"><img decoding="async" style="vertical-align: middle;" src="https://thebreakers.b-cdn.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/7-Bft-KiteHouse_birdseyeview.png" alt="" width="135" height="135" />Watch the 7 Bft KiteHouse from above</span></a></p>

<img decoding="async" class="nohover alignnone" src="https://thebreakers.b-cdn.net/wp-content/themes/enfold-child/images/sep.png" alt="Seperator" /></h2>
<p class="" data-start="1439" data-end="1495"><strong data-start="1439" data-end="1495">Island vibes &#038; steady winds – Kitesurfing in Somabay</strong></p>
<p class="" data-start="1497" data-end="1688">Step into true “island time” at our exclusive KiteHouse spot on the island of Somabay. Here, Caribbean vibes meet steady breezes – perfect for both kitesurfers and wing foilers of all levels.</p>
<h3 class="" data-start="1690" data-end="1739">What awaits you at the KiteHouse Island Spot:</h3>
<ul>
<li data-start="1742" data-end="1811">Daily downwind trips &#038; shuttle service between KiteHouse and island</li>
<li data-start="1742" data-end="1811">Wide launch and landing zones for kites and wings</li>
<li data-start="1742" data-end="1811">Dedicated rescue service with motorboat and trained assistants</li>
<li data-start="1742" data-end="1811">Live tracking for full safety on the water</li>
<li data-start="1742" data-end="1811">Chill-out area with sun loungers, umbrellas &#038; private swimming zone</li>
<li data-start="1742" data-end="1811">Caribbean-style bar &#038; restaurant for snacks and refreshing drinks</li>
</ul>
<p class="" data-start="2123" data-end="2281">Whether you&#8217;re riding the wind or just soaking up the sun, our KiteHouse spot on the island is the place to be – for kiters, families, and beach lovers alike.</p>
<p class="" data-start="2283" data-end="2352"><strong data-start="2283" data-end="2352">Feel the island vibe – at Somabay’s most exclusive kitesurf spot.</strong></p>

<div class='flex_column av-8xzotk-011f7221c9b3640e2302b07b5c00b7fc av_one_half avia-builder-el-55 avia-builder-el-no-sibling first flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding ' ><section class='av_textblock_section av-7sapbs-c93f43834bb20d843525f09c15678f83 ' itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock' itemprop="text" ><ul>
<li>Additional offers: downwinder, SUP, wakeboarding &#038; wakesurfing, banana boat</li>
<li>Restaurant with panorama terrace and kitesurf bar</li>
<li>Beach volleyball, table soccer</li>
<li>Shop with kite accessories &#038; repair service</li>
<li>Storage room</li>
<li>Reachable within 8 minutes by free shuttle</li>
<li>Flatwater paradise with wind speeds between 4 and 8 Bft</li>
<li>Support from VDWS certified kiting instructors</li>
<li>State-of-the-art rental equipment with 120 kites and 60 boards (Core, Carved, goodboards)</li>
<li>Top rescue service, start and landing support</li>
</ul>
</div></section></div>
